# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest stable release. Upgrade to the latest release before reporting an issue against an older version.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/apimgr/jokes/security/advisories/new) as the primary reporting channel. Do not report vulnerabilities in public issues or discussions. On a mirror without private reporting, submit the report to the GitHub origin repository first.

The public security overview is rendered at `/server/security`, and deployed instances serve the machine-readable policy at `/.well-known/security.txt`. The current `/server/contact` page is informational and does not accept submissions. Do not send vulnerability details there; use GitHub private vulnerability reporting.

Maintainers will acknowledge a private report, assess impact and coordinate a fix and disclosure with the reporter. Please allow up to 90 days for coordinated disclosure, unless a fix is released earlier or both parties agree to another date. Email is a secondary contact only when configured by the deployment; GitHub private reporting remains the primary path.
